status: Command flows /multilogin, /multilogout, /accounts and /switch-account verified against the unchanged upstream extension through Ui and Port fakes; the concrete host adapter, the pool manager screen and live TUI rendering are not covered
compared: Projected UI trace per scenario: every select, confirm and input control with its reply, and every pool manager call with its methods
Notifications: text and kind, with the account-file path normalized to $AUTH_PATH on both sides
Session entries appended by /switch-account, in order, with their data

Journal commit failures for selected-account and automatic switches: exact upstream thrown message, no appended entry and no success notification; native async journal acknowledgement is awaited before announcements
Final multiprovider-auth.json text, compared byte for byte, after the scenario's setup and command
Thrown messages of the command flow
Login flows: prompts and events in order and the resulting credential or error (multilogin.spec: API-key and OAuth flows)
Host select outcome and trace, including cancel (multilogin.spec: two cases)
Login dialog outcome and trace, including select without ctx.ui.select (multilogin.spec: one case)

A real request driven through the installed provider before /accounts and /switch-account: the failed account's cooldown state and its rendered status line, picker label and switch notification sentence
Every scripted answer and pool action is consumed by the Rust flow
limits: The Rust fake Port takes the service snapshot from the upstream reference, so scheduler snapshot behavior is not re-derived here.
Initial session pins are replayed from recorded switch-account entries that carry an accountId; pins applied by the real scheduler are not exercised.
The pool manager screen is a stub boundary (Port::pool_manager) and its edits to the pool buffer are not exercised.
Login outcomes come from scripted provider logins that the fake Port interprets; real provider login code is not executed.
Only Linux execution was performed; local-time formatting is UTC only and matches the reference's TZ=UTC.
notTested: Account-model cooldowns (`modelCooldowns` in the /accounts line): they need a virtual-provider failure, which belongs to the /vprovider lane; the projection is ported but not replayed.

'No switchable accounts' and 'Could not switch account' branches: ported but not replayed. Stored accounts always keep the upstream account switchable, and a pin fails only if the account disappears after the picker.
Non-ASCII case folding in provider references and switch labels: Rust to_lowercase may differ from JavaScript for a few code points.
Account ids longer than 8 UTF-16 code units in duplicate picker labels: the port slices Unicode scalar values, upstream slices code units; real ids (UUIDs, fixture-N) are ASCII.
Numbers at or above 1e21 in status lines.
Local time formatting: locale_time assumes UTC. Upstream toLocaleTimeString uses the process timezone; the fixture is generated with TZ=UTC, and no host time-zone source is exposed through Ui/Port.
Live dialog status panel: progress and waiting text are notifications, not a persistent panel (see docs/presentation-map.md).
OAuth selector fuzzy ranking: the query is handed to the native select; ranking is the native dialogs contract's responsibility.
